title: Power denominators for raw resolution cohomology
statement: Let f:X→T be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], I an injective resolution of F, q a natural number, W an affine open of T and a in Γ(T,W). Let K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write res:P(W)→P(D(a)) for its canonical restriction. Give P(D(a)) its Γ(T,W)-action by restriction of scalars along the structure-sheaf restriction. For every x in P(D(a)), there are n≥0 and y in P(W) such that a^n x=res(y). This asserts no kernel criterion.

source.place: Lemma 30.17.3, tensor-unit specialization, denominators part; Tag 01E4, Lemma 20.7.3, section complexes.

proof.text: Put Y=f⁻¹W and G=F|Y. Mathlib gives CompactSpace Y from f.isCompact_preimage hW.isCompact, and QuasiSeparatedSpace Y from quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (f restricted to W), using IsAffine W.toScheme. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Pull back a to the function b on Y and view it as the section s of the tensor unit. Apply invertS_cohomology Y L G s q to obtain the nonvanishing open U and the canonical additive equivalence e with its generator equation.

Use sectionCohomology_unit_comparisons to obtain the raw target equivalence t and numerator/twisted-target equivalences c_n,d_n with restriction and scalar equations. Compose e with t to form an additive homomorphism v from the fraction presentation to P(D(a)). Applying d_n to the generator equation of invertS_cohomology and composing with the two transport identities gives a^n v([n,ξ])=res(c_n ξ).

For each fraction class z prove that v(z) has a power denominator. Use QuotientAddGroup.induction_on on z and DirectSum.induction_on on its representative. Zero has exponent zero and numerator zero. A generator uses the preceding equation. If v(z),v(w) have denominators n,m and numerators y,y′, then v(z+w) has exponent n+m and numerator a^m y+a^n y′ by pow_add, mul_smul and linearity of the raw restriction map. Finally use surjectivity of e.trans t to obtain the assertion for every x. No fraction transition identities or single-fraction normalization are used.

proof_origin.place: Tensor-unit specialization followed by proved quotient/direct-sum induction; section-complex comparison isolated from Tags 01E1 and 01E4.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomologyPresheaf_pow_lifts {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let : Module Γ(T, W) (P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a))) :=
      Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
    ∀ x : P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)), ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : P.obj (op W)),
      a ^ n • x = (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom y
